validation: Same 1448-session cached H5 universe; grade all finite stocks in each original filtered validation cross section before splitting by its weekly style. backtests: Frozen primary lgb_full next-day forecast at t close. Use predicted label for the next session assigned to expert signals, also verify against one-session offset with same-day decision restrictions. Hard routes approved experts else v5; probability blend of approved standardized expert signals plus remaining mass on v5. Compare same execution v5 and historical s5. Same predeclared Top3 H5 ladder execution, historical window/cost, no fitted routing thresholds.
control: Old Top5-ES experts D/F/T/P and v5, all use exact prior official evaluation datasets and protocol.
